Through rich dialogue and character-driven narratives, readers are introduced to various characters such as Mr. Deck, his daughter Suzanne, and their friend Roth Sepel. The novel captures the unique blend of Alsatian culture and the conflicting feelings of belonging and allegiance, as the characters grapple with their experiences during the war, the return of French authority, and their relationships with their German neighbors.
